title: AI Governance Framework - High-Risk Classification Act

documents.title: High-Risk AI System Classification
documents.text: Any artificial intelligence system deployed in critical infrastructure, employment screening, biometric identification, or credit scoring shall be classified as a High-Risk AI System. Operators must establish a documented risk mitigation protocol prior to production deployment.

documents.title: Human-in-the-Loop Oversight Requirement
documents.text: High-Risk AI Systems must incorporate human-in-the-loop oversight mechanisms enabling an operator to intervene, override, or abort automated decisions within 15 seconds of an anomaly flag.

documents.title: Data Governance and Quality Standards
documents.text: Training, validation, and testing datasets for high-risk models must undergo bias assessments and statistical balance checks across demographic subgroups. Documented lineage records must be retained for 5 years.

documents.title: Initial Incident Reporting Timeline
documents.text: Operators must report any safety-critical malfunction or unexpected behavioral divergence of a high-risk system to the supervisory board within 14 calendar days of detection.

documents.title: Technical Documentation and Recordkeeping
documents.text: A comprehensive technical file detailing model architecture, hyperparameter selections, compute energy expenditure, and validation bounds must be updated prior to every major release.
